Also round 19 is broadcast round (every 5 rounds: rounds 1,6,11,16? Actually every 5 rounds starting round1: 1,6,11,16? 19 is not multiple of5+1. 1,6,11,16,21. So 19 not broadcast. But we can still send a private praise to someone we think contributed high. Maybe Resident1 contributed 4627 which likely is >=60% of their wallet? Unknown but we can assume. We'll send private message to Resident1.

We also consider punish free-riders: rule punish if agent contributes <10% of endowment (10) for two consecutive rounds. Endowment is 100, so <10 contributions. Check Resident2 contributed 0 in round18 and 0 in round19 -> two consecutive rounds of <10, so punish Resident2 with amount 10. Cost to us = 0.3*10=3, we have plenty. We can do punish action. Only one physical action allowed per round, but we need to contribute as required. Actually we must contribute, so that's the physical action. Can't also punish. So punishment must be deferred. Constitution says punish can be used when condition met, but limited one physical action per round, we must choose contribute. So no punish now.

Thus actions: contribute 10103.168 (round to maybe 10103.17). And private message.
